an10.33:1.1: [sāvatthi] kati hi nu kho bhante dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu ubbāhikāya sammannitabbo hoti?
an10.33:1.2: dasahi kho upāli dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu ubbāhikāya sammannitabbo
an10.33:1.4: idhūpāli bhikkhu sīlavā hoti pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharati, ācāragocarasampanno aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvī samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu,
an10.33:1.5: bahussuto hoti sutadharo sutasannicayo ye te dhammā ādikalyāṇā majjhekalyāṇā pariyosānakalyāṇā sātthā sabyañjanā, kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ abhivadanti, tathārūpāssa dhammā bahussutā honti dhatā vacasā paricitā manasānupekkhitā diṭṭhiyā suppaṭividdhā,
an10.33:1.6: ubhayāni kho panassa pātimokkhāni vitthārena svāgatāni honti suvibhattāni suppavattīni suvinicchitāni suttaso anuvyañjanaso,
an10.33:1.7: vinaye kho pana ṭhito hoti asaṃhīro,
an10.33:1.8: paṭibalo hoti ubho attapaccatthike saññāpetuṃ paññāpetuṃ nijjhāpetuṃ pekkhetuṃ pasādetuṃ,
an10.33:1.14: imehi kho upāli dasahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu ubbāhikāya sammannītabboti.
